create_tool_subclass: create a subclass of Tool that implements name, description, and execute for a custom LLM-invocable utility
implement_tool_execute: implement the execute method on a Tool subclass to perform an action and return a string result
define_tool_name: define the name property on a Tool subclass to return a unique lowercase identifier for LLM tool calls
define_tool_description: define the description property on a Tool subclass to explain what the tool does and its accepted arguments
build_web_search_tool: build a WebSearchTool subclass of Tool that searches the web and returns results as a string
